title: Breece Hall’s injury gives Jets’ Braelon Allen chance to prove he’s ‘workhorse back’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Breece Hall’s injury gives Jets’ Braelon Allen chance to prove he’s ‘workhorse back’
sources.description: Braelon Allen was honest ahead of the season about how important Year 3 was for him. A potentially significant moment in his young career has arrived.
